voice.name: Open Sector - Cyborg Commander
voice.description: Very deep, resonant male voice of a cybernetic officer who commands machines, heavily processed and metallic with a cold synthetic ring and a low electronic hum under every word, slow, deliberate and imperious, speaks with absolute authority and contempt, measured pauses, never raises his voice, chilling and regal.
voice.sample: Cyborg Commander online. Shield matrix charged. You will kneel, or you will burn. My beam does not miss, and my orders are not questioned.

fire.prompt: Sci-fi cutting laser weapon firing: short electric charge-up crackle, then a sustained searing high-energy beam hum and sizzle sweeping sideways, burning hiss of scorched ground, close, outdoors battlefield, no music, no voice

fire_line.prompt: Short powerful sci-fi laser beam burst hitting a steel tank, intense electric zap and molten metal cutting sizzle, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

shield_hit.prompt: Energy force field shield absorbing a bullet impact, short bright electric shimmer and zap, sci-fi, close, no music, no voice

shield_down.prompt: Sci-fi energy force field shield collapsing: descending electric whine, crackling sparks and a fading power-down hum, close, no music, no voice

shield_up.prompt: Sci-fi energy force field shield recharging and switching back on: rising electric hum ending in a soft resonant shimmer, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Heavy armored cyborg walking: deep servo motor whine, hydraulic hiss and very heavy metallic footsteps thudding on dirt, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Large cyborg destroyed: energy shield emitter shorting out with a loud electric crackle and buzz, sparks, servos powering down, heavy metal body crashing onto the ground, close, no music, no voice

uplink.prompt: Sci-fi command uplink beam locking onto a machine: a warbling electronic carrier tone, fast modem-like data chatter and digital chirps, a rising resonant hum, close, no music, no voice
